summary: JD-centric template profile for a senior hybrid cloud and data engineering role focused on scalable AWS platforms, Terraform-managed infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, and Databricks data pipelines. Emphasizes Python and Apache Spark engineering, production integration of LLMs through OpenAI API and Claude, LangChain-based GenAI workflows, and platform observability. Template content requires candidate review and validation before use as personal experience.

experience.title: Senior AI DevOps & Data Engineer
bullets: Template scope: Deploy and maintain scalable Kubernetes environments on AWS using Terraform, supporting consistent cloud infrastructure and reliable production workflows.
Design Databricks data engineering pipelines with Apache Spark and Python, emphasizing maintainability, processing efficiency, and dependable delivery of large-scale data.
Integrate LLMs through OpenAI API and Claude to generate automated operational insights and support AI-powered platform workflows.
Develop GenAI capabilities and AI agent architectures with LangChain, connecting model-driven features to production data and operational processes.
Establish observability practices for cloud, data, and AI workloads to improve platform reliability, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.
